title: HorizontalPodAutoscaler autoscaling/v2beta2 is no longer served
summary: The Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide states that the autoscaling/v2beta2 API version of HorizontalPodAutoscaler is no longer served as of v1.26, which was released on 2022-12-09.

constraints: Keep the scaling targets and the min and max replica counts unchanged.
In autoscaling/v2, targetAverageUtilization is replaced by target.averageUtilization together with target.type: Utilization.

steps.title: Change the HorizontalPodAutoscaler apiVersion
steps.instructions: Change the reported `apiVersion` to `autoscaling/v2` and rewrite any metric target fields that use the old names.

steps.title: Align other HorizontalPodAutoscaler declarations
steps.instructions: Update every other manifest, Helm template, and kustomize patch or target that names the old API version, so the repository agrees.

verification.purpose: Validate the migrated manifests against the schemas of the target Kubernetes version.
Ask a cluster on the target version to accept the migrated manifest without applying it.
For a Helm chart, render it and validate the output.
